items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I went back in again with Hodes and Lee Collins, and stayed there 14 weeks. ... I was playing with Hodes at, I didn't know what it was all about. I'm playing with Hodes up at the Childs.

ctx.x: Bob Wilbur, is he with you?

No, I had, uh, Harry Green on clarinet, and his drummer that plays like Buddy Rich, what's his name? Well, I just can't remember. Anyway, I'm sure you work all over there. Most of the guys, uh, most of the guys were at the, uh, Rhymes. So we came out here, and we stayed, uh, we were supposed to be there two weeks, and we stayed six months. And at the weekends, it was beginning to pick up mouth-to-mouth publicity. So then I got an offer to go into the Blue Note. And just then, the band quit me, went back to New…

items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And I had George Brunies, I remember. And George went to Harlem with Sidney to keep him from coming back with his knife

ctx.x: This was '43, '44. Okay, Mezz, Pee Wee Russell, Rod Cless, I had all three. Trumpets, Max Kaminsky, Muggsy Spanier, Fred Allen, drums, George Wettling, or Freddy Moore or Kaiser Marshall, whoever was available. And Pops Foster always on bass.

Trombone, Sandy Williams, -- I don't know who else was around. But these were the musicians that -- Sidney Bechet, I had Sidney many times. In fact, I've got a story about Sidney. This was the first time I had Sidney. I hired him, I told him the date. Everybody showed up but Sidney. Well, I'm in a quandary. Here I advertised Sidney, and no Sidney. So I had my gopher who was helping me run around, and he comes back with two clarinet players, Mezz and Rod, to make up for it. So the people are happy.

items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I says, well, I'd like to have George Brunis who's available... But I did get that date because of George not being able to make it.

ctx.x: And myself. And George is in the back, and I don't know who he's with. But they were talking about the same subject, about having a seance and all that. Murphy says, what the hell are they talking about? I says, I don't know, they didn't give me any.
